verdict.headline: Extremely one-sided NDA imposing perpetual liability, broad indemnities, and no protection for your own tender data or recipes.
summary: The contract gives zero protection to your confidential information, allowing the discloser to freely share your recipes and pricing with competitors.

It imposes an uncapped indemnity and permits only the discloser to terminate or assign the agreement.

verdict.headline: Hong Kong governing law, a tiny RM 50 liability cap, and total exclusion of perishable goods create extreme commercial risk.
summary: The agreement subjects local Malaysian delivery disputes to Hong Kong courts, making any legal enforcement prohibitively expensive.
The carrier caps liability at RM 50 per parcel and expressly excludes perishable goods like fresh flowers, gutting remedies for your core business.
This contract is governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; we check it against Malaysian law only as a fallback.

findings.title: Severe RM 50 Liability Cap and Exclusion of Perishables
findings.quote: The Carrier's liability for any loss of or damage to a Parcel, for delay, or for any other claim connected with that Parcel is limited to RM 50 per Parcel, regardless of the Declared Value of the Parcel and regardless of the cause of the loss.

findings.suggested_ask: Can we revise Clause 4.2 so that compensation is based on the Declared Value of the Parcel, or include an option for transit insurance cover?

findings.title: Daily Compounding Late Fees and Increased Default Interest Rate
findings.quote: If an instalment is not paid when due, a late fee of 0.5% of the overdue amount is charged for each day it remains unpaid. The late fee for each day is added to the overdue amount at the end of that day, and the late fee for the following day is calculated on the new total, so that the late fee compounds daily until the overdue amount and all late fees are paid in full.
findings.why_risky: Daily compounding fees of 0.5% per day accumulate exponentially into an enormous debt. Under s. 17 of the Moneylenders Act 1951, licensed moneylending agreements cannot lawfully charge compound interest or increase interest rates upon default.
findings.standard: Under Malaysian moneylending law, moneylenders are barred from charging compound interest or increasing rates on default; late charges should not compound.

findings.title: Open-Ended All-Monies Guarantee
findings.quote: In consideration of the Lender making the Loan, the Guarantor guarantees to the Lender the payment of everything the Borrower owes under this Agreement and any other debt the Borrower may owe the Lender now or in future.
findings.why_risky: The guarantee binds the guarantor not just to this specific RM 20,000 loan, but to any present or future unknown debts incurred by the borrower without limitation.
findings.standard: A guarantee should strictly be limited to the principal and interest of the specific loan facility being entered into.
findings.suggested_ask: Can we limit the guarantee solely to the obligations under this specific RM 20,000 loan agreement?

findings.quote: The Guarantor shall be liable for all costs, charges and expenses of every kind that the Lender incurs in connection with the Loan, this Agreement or the guarantee, including legal costs on a full indemnity basis, collection costs and the cost of tracing the Borrower, whether or not they relate to the Loan still owed. The Guarantor's liability is not limited to the amount of the Loan.
findings.why_risky: The guarantor takes on uncapped liability including full indemnity costs, investigation, and tracing expenses, extending well beyond the principal loan amount.
findings.standard: Guarantor liability should be capped at the total amount owed under the specific loan schedule plus reasonable, documented legal costs.

findings.title: Variation of Terms Without Guarantor Consent

findings.standard: Any material variation, extension, or increase of the underlying credit facility should require prior written consent from the guarantor, failing which the guarantor is released.
